row.evidence: GitKraken's current pricing page and SSO docs mention SSO (Advanced and up) and just-in-time provisioning but no SCIM at any tier; the only SCIM mention on GitKraken's sites is "SCIM provisioning (coming soon)" on the 2023 Enterprise plan page.
row.notes: Status changed from gated (June) to none: the June row said Enterprise adds SCIM provisioning, but no current first-party page supports it. The pricing page (Pro, Advanced, Business, Enterprise) lists no SCIM, the help centre (2,700 URLs in its sitemap, WordPress search for 'scim' and 'provisioning') has no SCIM article, and the only hit is the 2023 plans page listing 'SCIM provisioning (coming soon)' under Enterprise. The June estimate of $15-25/u/mo had no first-party source and is dropped. Team plan price changed: Pro is now $10 per seat per month billed annually (June: $4.95), with a limited-time first-seat price of $6. SSO starts at Advanced ($14, single domain); multi-domain SSO needs Business (price loaded by script, not reliably captured) or Enterprise per the pricing page (the SSO help article says Enterprise). Provisioning alternatives: SAML JIT (consumes a licence; needs free licences) and CSV user import. No user-management API is documented; the only public API is the Insights Manual Releases API.

plans.price_text: Per seat, per month, paid annually (amount is filled in by script and A/B-tested; one headless render showed $18)

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Adds security audit logs (no audit-log API documented).

limitations.text: GitKraken's 2023 plans page listed SCIM provisioning as 'coming soon' for Enterprise; no current page documents it as shipped.

scim.notes: SCIM not documented anywhere on GitKraken's current pricing page or help centre.

limitations.text: The only documented public API (https://api.gitkraken.dev, bearer API key) is the GitKraken Insights Manual Releases API; it has no user or membership endpoints.

okta.notes: okta.com/integrations/gitkraken/ returns 404; GitKraken's SSO guide sets Okta up as a custom internal SAML app.

entra.notes: No Microsoft Learn tutorial at entra/identity/saas-apps/gitkraken-tutorial (404); GitKraken's SSO guide creates a non-gallery Enterprise application.

jumpcloud.notes: GitKraken does not appear in JumpCloud's SSO & SCIM application guide index (checked on the JumpCloud help-centre navigation).
